simple.meaning: נָגִיד (nâgîyd) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a commander (as occupying the front ), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Samuel 9:16. The surrounding context includes family, kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָגִיד (H5057) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: נָגִיד (nâgîyd) / H5057 is traced through 1 Samuel 9:16, 1 Samuel 10:1, 1 Samuel 13:14, 1 Samuel 25:30 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.usage: captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.
definitions.full: H5057. nagid נָגִיד noun masculine leader (literally probably one in front ), ruler, prince; — absolute ׳נ 1Sam 9:16 31t.; construct נְגִיד (נְגִד) 2Kin 20:5-6 t.; plural נְגִידִים Job 29:10 3 t.; נְגִידֵי 2Chr 35:8 ; — ruler, prince Psalm 76:13; Prov 28:16 ; Job 29:10 ; 31:37 (in simile). Especially 1 of king of Israel: of Saul לְנ ׳מָשַׁח עַל (+ accusative of person), 1Sam 9:16 (subject prophet), compare of Solomon, subject people, 1Chr 29:22 ; 10:1 (subject ׳י ); of David לְנ ׳צִוָּהוּ עַל 1Sam 13:14 ; 25:30 , ׳נ צִוָּהוּ עַל 2Sam 6:21 (in these ׳י subject), לנ ׳היה על 5:2 , נ ׳היה על 7:8 ; 1Chr 11:2 ; 17:7 ; compare also 5:2 ; 2Chr 6:5 ; of David also נ ׳נָתַן ׳לְ Isa 55:4 ; of Solomon נ ׳לִהְיוֺת על אֹתוֺ צִוָּה 1Kin 1:35 ( ׳י subject); of Jeroboam נ ׳נתן על ( + accusative of person) 14:7 ( ׳י subject); so 16:2 of Baasha; of Hezekiah ׳נְ עַָמִּי 2Kin 20:5 ; ׳לְנ בְּאֶחָיו הֶעֱמִיד ( + accusative of person) 2Chr 11:22 (of Abijah, subject Rehob.); of Judah 1Chr 28:4 . 2 of a foreign ruler or prince Ezek 28:2 ; Dan 9:25-26 ,. 3 the title of some high official connected with the temple Jer 20:1 (of Pashhur) י ׳בבית נָגִיד פָקִיד וְהוּא and he was prince-overseer in, etc. (for ׳פ see 29:26 ); hence ׳נ האלהים בית 1Chr 9:11 ; 2Chr 31:13 ; 35:8 (three ב ׳נגידי ׳ה , including the high-priest), Neh 11:11 ; of high-priest Dan 11:22 נ ׳בְּרִית . 4 ruler in other capacities (late): of tribe 1Chr 27:16 ; 2Chr 19:11 ; of Korahites 9:20 ; of Aaronite warriors 2 Chron 12:27; of division of army 1Chr 13:1 ; 27:4 ; 2Chr 11:11 (commandant of fortress), 32:21 (in Assyrian army: || שַׂר ); of temple-treasuries 1Chr 26:24 , compare 2Chr 31:12 ; ׳נ הבית 28:7 (i.e. of palace?). 5 princely thimgs , plural abstract Prov 8:6 .
